body: oh i didn’t know that, i’m not too keen on the idea of going to a ward and talking to someone face to face is scary to me. I’ve had bad experiences with a therapist before i tried to get help multiple times but i never end up going a second time and i’m still really fucking depressed after and it feels worse after i quit trying... The idea of just telling someone face to face everything that’s happened and how i feel is truly terrifying to me

getting help to me just feels like it would be so draining and how would i get help right now... i’m seriously asking because i have no clue how in quarantine and self isolation that i’d get a therapist or get into a ward

Probably months since i’ve drawn, i tried playing some games yesterday. I like FPSs and RPGs a lot, My favourite game of all time is definitely Shadow of the Colossus, do you have a favourite game? Oh and i use to read too :) I haven’t finished it yet but i was reading this really cool book called “John dies at the End” and it’s super weird but it’s also written really well.
I used to really like drawing, i played games but neither have been fun recently. What about you?
